name: Attio
one_liner: Attio is a highly customizable CRM platform offering a public REST API and an App SDK for building integrations and automations.

surfaces.access_note: Developers can generate an API key for a single workspace or use OAuth 2.0 for up to 25 workspaces without publishing.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to generate an access token: 1. By implementing an OAuth 2.0 flow 2. By generating an API key for your workspace
Pass the value of the token in the Authorization header of your requests like so. Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
We also support HTTP Basic Authentication, where the username is the token and the password is left blank.
If you only need a token for a single workspace, you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
App SDK This allows developers to embed Typescript React applications within the Attio interface and run server functions with access to our REST API.
MCP Manage Attio via AI. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice to search, update and manage your Attio workspace.
